Treat FFN as a sensitivity amplifier and token2+ K/V history as inherited state drift; do not rerun FFN-tail, FFN-RMSNorm, or full-attention core precision variants without a new upstream residual/input-drift reduction route.

Added diagnostic-only native residual and native pre-token state realignment controls to test whether the post-FP32 failures are bounded by residual/state accumulation. Greedy top-1 stayed exact in all probes, but no realignment route passed required checks: layer-3 residual snap fell to 4/8 exact top-k at 5.780573462 tok/s, layers 0-3 residual snap stayed 4/8 at 5.783852998 tok/s, native state realignment improved to 6/8 at 5.384924823 tok/s, native state plus layers 0-3 stayed 6/8 at 5.736237747 tok/s, and native state plus layers 0-15 regressed to 5/8 at 5.891191613 tok/s. State realignment fixed tokens 3 and 4 but tokens 6 and 7 still failed; adding early residual snaps moved first drift later (token 6 layer 9, token 7 layer 13) without closing top-k. Do not promote oracle state/residual realignment or rerun residual snap ladders; next isolate local per-token drift under native state around the later failing layers.

Added diagnostic layer-window controls for residual, FFN component, full-attention source, and core-pregate reports, then ran native-state source windows 6:17, 4:12, and 0:6 with token_limit=8. Greedy top-1 stayed exact and exact top-k remained 6/8 in all source-window runs. The windows show the remaining native-state failures are local early numerical drift, not a late full-attention or FFN-tail kernel bug: token 6 has a layer-3 FFN residual seed around 0.000156 that layer-4/5 linear final and FFN/router paths amplify; token 7 starts at layer 2/3 (about 0.000493/0.000992 residual drift) and layer-4 FFN/router amplification. Same-input GPU kernels still match CPU for linear qkv/z/final, attention output projection, and FFN tail. Do not rerun local source windows, component placement toggles, or oracle residual snaps; next choose a real numerical parity correction at the early residual-producing path.

Added default-off --cpu-layer-fallback-layers to run listed layers through the real CPU stateful layer implementations from the current live residual/state and write the live linear/full-attention state, not oracle residual snaps. The scaffold compiled locally and layer accounting passed, but it is not a correction: L0-3 fallback kept greedy top-1 exact and fell to 4/8 exact top-k at 4.733946681 tok/s, while L0-5 fallback also stayed 4/8 at 4.410441538 tok/s. This regresses below the native-state 6/8 result and still fails tokens 3, 4, 6, and 7, so CPU fallback widening is diagnostic only; do not rerun fallback ladders unless a specific boundary/state-handshake bug is identified.

Reran the post-FP32-core 8-token diagnostic with resident GPU Q6 LM-head disabled so final output norm and LM-head projection returned to the CPU path. Greedy top-1 stayed exact, exact top-k remained 5/8, and throughput regressed to 5.256778210 tok/s. The failure shape matched the GPU LM-head run at tokens 3, 6, and 7, including token 3 [579,725,513,11,82] vs native [579,513,725,11,1144], token 6 [1817,97424,7188,8240,10978] vs native [1817,97424,8240,7188,100979], and token 7 [25,421,271,51595,279] vs native [25,421,271,51595,6007]. The LM-head Q6 boundary is not the remaining correctness cause; do not rerun CPU/GPU LM-head placement toggles for this drift.

Added a default-off resident linear recurrent-state readback path and --sync-resident-linear-state-host to compare native and GPU resident linear states after each token under native pre-token state realignment. The generated probe compiled locally with only known unused diagnostic constants, and the target run kept greedy top-1 exact and exact top-k at 6/8 while slowing to 4.386626831 tok/s because it read back 240 layer states. It still failed tokens 6 and 7. For token 6, layers 0-2 recurrent state was effectively exact (max_abs <= 1.91e-6) and first cosine<0.9999 was layer 17; for token 7, layers 0-1 were exact and layer-2 recurrent max_abs was 0.0006388 while the layer-boundary residual was already 0.0004929 and router IDs diverged at layer 2. Resident linear-state host drift is therefore not the missing correction; treat this as evidence pointing back to early residual/input numerical parity rather than state-buffer synchronization.

Added default-off --opencl-no-fma to prefix generated OpenCL with #pragma OPENCL FP_CONTRACT OFF and replace the generated full-attention qk/value explicit fma accumulations with separate multiply/add after the FP32-core correction. The generated probe compiled locally with only known unused diagnostic constants, and source inspection confirmed the pragma plus non-fma full-core accumulations. Target run kept greedy top-1 exact and exact top-k at 6/8 with 5.520897009 tok/s, but required checks still failed. It changed the failure shape rather than fixing it: token 6 became exact top-k, token 3 regressed, and token 7 still failed. Early residual drift remains in the same tiny local L2-L4 path under native-state realignment, with same-input FFN/output kernels still CPU-equivalent. Do not rerun OpenCL FP-contraction/no-fma variants without a new source-level arithmetic mismatch beyond this route.

Added default-off --linear-delta-cpu-shape to make the generated OpenCL linear-attention recurrent update CPU-shaped: decay state into the output state buffer, accumulate sum_k from stored decayed values, update the stored row, then accumulate sum_q from stored updated values. The generated probe compiled locally with only known unused diagnostic constants and source inspection confirmed the separated phases. Target run kept greedy top-1 exact but regressed exact top-k to 3/8 at 5.536300035 tok/s, failing tokens 0, 1, 3, 6, and 7. It did move token 7's first material drift later from layer 2 to layer 4, but token correctness regressed. The combined --linear-delta-cpu-shape --opencl-no-fma run also failed, matching the no-FMA shape at 6/8 exact top-k and 5.450215817 tok/s. Linear-delta CPU-shaped storage/contraction control is therefore diagnostic only; do not rerun this arithmetic variant family without a new formula-level mismatch.

Added default-off --linear-l2-double-sum to make the generated OpenCL linear-attention L2 normalization accumulate each q/k head's sum of squares in double, then cast to float for sqrt, matching the CPU postconv l2_norm_heads accumulation shape. The generated probe compiled locally with only known unused diagnostic constants, source inspection confirmed cl_khr_fp64 plus double accumulation, and the target OpenCL compiler accepted the kernel. Target run kept greedy top-1 exact but regressed exact top-k to 4/8 at 5.646511731 tok/s, failing tokens 0, 3, 6, and 7. Early token 6/7 residual drift did not materially improve relative to the native-state 6/8 diagnostic. Linear L2 double accumulation is therefore not the missing correction; do not rerun this L2 accumulation-precision variant without a new source-level mismatch.

Added default-off --opencl-double-sigmoid to replace generated OpenCL sigmoid_f32 with a CPU-shaped double-precision stable sigmoid and enable cl_khr_fp64. This affects linear postconv SiLU, linear final z gating, FFN SwiGLU, and shared gate application while leaving the default path unchanged. The generated probe compiled locally with only known unused diagnostic constants, source inspection confirmed the fp64 pragma and double sigmoid body, and the target OpenCL compiler accepted the kernel. Target run kept greedy top-1 exact but exact top-k regressed to 5/8 at 5.411733001 tok/s, failing tokens 0, 6, and 7. Early token 6/7 residual drift did not materially improve and token 0 regressed, so OpenCL double sigmoid is not the missing correction; do not rerun sigmoid-precision variants without a new source-level mismatch.

Added default-off --opencl-double-swiglu to compute the whole generated OpenCL FFN SwiGLU product in double for both ffn_moe_swiglu_f32 kernels, matching the CPU selected-FFN product shape more closely than the prior double-sigmoid route. The generated probe compiled locally with only known unused diagnostic constants, source inspection confirmed cl_khr_fp64 plus exactly two double-product rewrites, and the target OpenCL compiler accepted the kernel. Target run kept greedy top-1 exact but exact top-k regressed to 4/8 at 5.371584054 tok/s, failing tokens 0, 3, 6, and 7. This is worse than native-state 6/8 and double-sigmoid 5/8, and early token 6/7 residual drift did not materially improve, so OpenCL FFN SwiGLU product precision is not the missing correction; do not rerun SwiGLU product precision variants without a new source-level mismatch.

Added default-off --opencl-cpu-sqrt-norm to replace generated OpenCL rsqrt scale expressions with CPU-shaped 1.0f / sqrt(...) in the linear recurrent output scale, linear-attention final norm, and hidden RMSNorm kernel. The generated probe compiled locally with only known unused diagnostic constants, and source inspection confirmed all three intended rewrites. Target run kept greedy top-1 exact and exact top-k at 6/8 with the same failure shape as the native-state baseline, failing tokens 6 and 7, while slowing to 5.406298847 tok/s. Early token 6/7 residual drift and first-seven layer output diffs were unchanged, so rsqrt-vs-sqrt normalization scale shape is not the missing correction; do not rerun CPU-sqrt normalization variants without a new source-level mismatch.

Added default-off --opencl-q6-lane-sums to make the generated OpenCL q6k_selected_down_matvec_row kernel match the CPU Q6 dot reduction order: accumulate eight float lane sums across all Q6 blocks, then reduce lanes once at the end. This targeted the token-7 layer-2 linear Q6 QKV/Z amplification path. The generated probe compiled locally with only known unused diagnostic constants and source inspection confirmed the lane-sum rewrite. Target run kept greedy top-1 exact but exact top-k regressed to 5/8 at 5.406872337 tok/s, failing tokens 3, 6, and 7. Token-7 layer-2 projection-input and attention-output drift did not materially improve, and token 3 regressed, so Q6 lane-reduction order is not the missing correction; do not rerun Q6 lane-order variants or combine them with closed precision toggles without a new source-level mismatch.

Omitted --resident-linear-q6-qkv while keeping --resident-linear-conv-weights to force Q6 QKV through the nonresident RunQ6QkvThenConvPreconv path with raw tensor bytes, isolating resident-Q6 placement from the early layer-2 residual drift. Generate-only artifact confirmed resident_linear_q6_qkv=false and resident_linear_conv_weights=true. Target run kept greedy top-1 exact and exact top-k at 6/8, failing tokens 6 and 7, but slowed to 4.058480276 tok/s. Token 3/6/7 first-six layer boundary and linear-preconv source diffs were identical to the native-state resident-Q6 baseline, so resident-vs-nonresident linear Q6 QKV placement is not the missing correction; do not rerun linear-Q6 placement probes without a new source-level mismatch.

Combined the closed --opencl-q6-lane-sums and --opencl-no-fma diagnostics after source evidence showed lane-sums reduced the local Q6 same-input error but still left a possible contracted scale*lane_sum update. Generate-only artifact confirmed both the FP_CONTRACT OFF pragma and the Q6 float lane-sum rewrite. Target run made early Q6 QKV same-input diffs exact for layers 0-4, but exact top-k regressed to 4/8 at 5.483556497 tok/s, failing tokens 3, 4, 6, and 7. With Q6 QKV exact, token-7 layer-0 still had residual drift from non-Q6 preconv/delta components, so combined Q6 lane-order plus FP-contraction control is not the missing correction; do not rerun this combination without a new downstream source mismatch.

Added default-off --resident-q4-cpu-order-linear-ab to route linear alpha/beta Q4 projections through the existing Q4 CPU-order runner, targeting the same-input gate/beta drift exposed after the Q6 QKV path was made exact. Generate-only artifact confirmed the alpha/beta branch uses RunResidentRawQ4KCpuOrder and the target warmed 90 Q4 CPU-order handles. Target run kept greedy top-1 exact but exact top-k regressed to 5/8 at 5.479143872 tok/s, failing tokens 1, 3, and 7; token 6 became exact while tokens 1 and 3 regressed. Beta same-input diffs became exact and gate diffs shrank in several layers, but the token-7 layer-2/4 residual shape persisted, so Q4 CPU-order alpha/beta projection is not the missing correction; do not rerun alpha/beta placement/order variants without a new source-level mismatch.

Added default-off --cpu-linear-postconv-prep to recompute linear-attention postconv prep q/k/v predelta vectors on CPU from the GPU conv output, using CPU-shaped SiLU and double-accumulated L2 normalization, then feed those vectors into the existing GPU delta path. Generate-only artifact confirmed the flag, helper, delta substitution, trace substitution, and JSON output wiring. Target run built and emitted smoke JSON; greedy top-1 stayed exact, but exact top-k regressed from the native-state 6/8 baseline to 5/8 at 5.445698674 tok/s, failing tokens 0, 4, and 7. Token 7 layer-2 q/k/v predelta drift became near-exact, but exact top-k still failed and tokens 0/4 regressed, so CPU postconv-prep substitution is not the missing correction; do not rerun postconv-prep CPU substitution or L2/SILU shape variants without a new downstream source mismatch.

Combined the new --cpu-linear-postconv-prep diagnostic with the existing --cpu-ffn-rmsnorm diagnostic after CPU postconv-prep moved token-7 material drift from linear layer 2 to layer-3 FFN amplification. Target run built and emitted smoke JSON; greedy top-1 stayed exact, but exact top-k regressed further to 4/8 at 5.33941306 tok/s, failing tokens 0, 3, 6, and 7. Token-7 layer-3/4 boundary and FFN component drift were unchanged from CPU postconv-prep alone, so FFN RMSNorm CPU substitution does not pair with CPU postconv-prep to close the remaining failure; do not rerun this combined CPU postconv/RMSNorm diagnostic without a new upstream residual source mismatch.

Added default-off --cpu-linear-delta to recompute the linear-attention recurrent delta/state on CPU from live GPU postconv q/k/v/gate/beta/z inputs, refresh the resident linear-state handle for each substituted layer, and feed the existing GPU attention-front path. Generate-only artifact confirmed the flag, CPU delta helper call, per-layer resident-state refresh, JSON output wiring, and manifest field; local compile passed with only known unused diagnostic constants. Target run built and emitted smoke JSON; greedy top-1 stayed exact, but exact top-k regressed from the native-state 6/8 baseline to 5/8 at 4.680371205 tok/s, failing tokens 3, 6, and 7. Token 7 layer-2 output drift dropped from 0.0004928875715 to 1.937150955e-7, but layer-3 FFN residual drift remained about 0.00012948 and token 3 newly regressed, so CPU linear delta/state substitution is not the missing correction; do not rerun CPU linear-delta substitution without a new upstream residual source mismatch.

Combined --native-state-realign-each-token with the existing --cpu-layer-fallback-layers 0,1,2,3 to test the state-handshake gap left by the rejected live CPU fallback and residual-only native snaps. Target run built and emitted smoke JSON; greedy top-1 stayed 8/8 and exact top-k stayed 6/8, still failing tokens 6 and 7, while slowing to 4.660862074 tok/s. Layers 0-3 became exact and first material boundary drift moved later than the native-state baseline (token 6 first output cosine<0.9999 moved from layer 6 to 11; token 7 from layer 4 to 14), but top-k did not close. This proves exact early CPU execution plus native pre-token state is still only a diagnostic realignment, not the missing correction; do not continue CPU fallback ladder/state combinations without a new post-L0-3 boundary/state hypothesis.

Added default-off --cpu-linear-conv to recompute the linear-attention convolution output/state on CPU from live GPU qkv and force CPU postconv prep to consume that substituted conv output. Generate-only codegen and local compile passed with only the known unused diagnostic constants. The unclamped target run was confounded by already-known early full-attention drift and regressed exact top-k to 3/8, so the decisive run paired the new conv hypothesis with --native-state-realign-each-token and --cpu-layer-fallback-layers 0,1,2,3. That L0-3-clamped run built and emitted smoke JSON; greedy top-1 stayed 8/8 and exact top-k stayed 6/8 at 4.457629086 tok/s, failing tokens 3 and 7. It fixed the prior token-6 top-k ordering but introduced a token-3 mismatch and moved token 7's first material boundary drift earlier than the L0-3 state-handshake baseline (layer 11 instead of 14), so CPU linear-conv/state substitution is not the missing correction. Do not rerun CPU conv/postconv substitutions or combine them with fallback/state ladders without a new source-level state-layout mismatch.

Added default-off --opencl-double-softmax to rewrite the generated full-attention core to a CPU-shaped double dot/softmax path while still casting scores and weights through float at the same points as the CPU reference. Generate-only codegen confirmed the FP64 extension and double-softmax source; local compile passed with only known unused diagnostic constants. Target run built and emitted smoke JSON; greedy top-1 and greedy prefix stayed 8/8, but exact top-k stayed 5/8 at 4.76185661 tok/s, failing tokens 3, 6, and 7. Same-input full-attention core diffs were reduced to about 2.38e-7 with cosines above 0.9999, but exact top-k did not close, so full-core score normalization/softmax arithmetic is not the missing correction. Do not rerun softmax/exp/full-core score-normalization variants without a new source-level mismatch.

Extended the existing default-off --opencl-double-sigmoid path to also rewrite the generated full-attention gate inline sigmoid, which the older diagnostic flag had not covered. Generate-only codegen confirmed the FP64 extension and sigmoid_d full-attention gate source; local compile passed with only known unused diagnostic constants. Target run built and emitted smoke JSON; greedy top-1 and greedy prefix stayed 8/8, but exact top-k stayed 5/8 at 5.696689203 tok/s, failing tokens 3, 4, and 6. This closes the remaining direct full-attention sigmoid arithmetic variant; do not rerun sigmoid/gate variants without a new source-level mismatch.

Combined --opencl-double-softmax with the extended --opencl-double-sigmoid full-attention gate rewrite to test CPU-shaped full-attention core softmax plus gate sigmoid arithmetic together. Generate-only codegen confirmed both double max_score softmax and sigmoid_d gate source; local compile passed with only known unused diagnostic constants. Target run built and emitted smoke JSON; greedy top-1 and greedy prefix stayed 8/8, but exact top-k regressed to 4/8 at 4.567694009 tok/s, failing tokens 0, 3, 6, and 7. Do not combine full-core softmax and gate-sigmoid variants further without new evidence.

Added default-off --cpu-residual-add to recompute post-attention and post-FFN residual additions on CPU from live GPU component outputs while keeping the resident Q4/Q6 projection and selected/shared FFN routes active. The attention-front handoff diagnostic reruns the resident output projection only to recover the projection vector, then feeds CPU residual add and CPU RMSNorm; the FFN tail recomputes moe_out/shared-gated/ffn_out from live GPU down outputs and the CPU shared input gate before CPU residual add. Generate-only codegen and local compile passed with only known unused diagnostic constants. Target run built and emitted smoke JSON; greedy top-1 and greedy prefix stayed 8/8, but exact top-k regressed to 4/8 at 5.425875264 tok/s, failing tokens 0, 3, 6, and 7. GPU FFN output still matched CPU recompute from the same GPU input, so residual-add substitution is not the missing early residual/input correction; do not rerun CPU residual-add variants without a new source-level residual mismatch.

Added default-off --full-attention-state-diff plus manifest-visible opencl_full_core_fp32 fields to make the existing FP32 full-core baseline and K/V history state drift auditable without changing decode behavior. Generate-only codegen and local compile passed. Target run built and emitted smoke JSON; greedy top-1 and greedy prefix stayed 8/8, but exact top-k remained 5/8 at 5.870938938 tok/s with the same FP32-core failure shape at tokens 3, 6, and 7. The new state/cache evidence shows full-attention V history first crosses cosine<0.9999 at layer 15 on step 1 and layer 3 from step 2 onward; K history crosses at layer 11 on step 2 and layer 3 from step 4 onward. This proves full-attention K/V history drift is inherited early enough that full-core handoff reruns require a concrete state/cache correction plan; do not rerun state-diff instrumentation or full-core handoff for this failure without that plan.

After the current-FP32 full-core attention-front handoff passed the one-token rerun and confirmation, ran the matching 8-token state check under the same canonical resident flags. Greedy top-1 and greedy prefix stayed exact at 8/8, but exact top-k regressed to 4/8 at 5.821305357 tok/s, failing tokens 3, 4, 6, and 7. The full-core handoff fired for 80 layers with 45230.512 us aggregate handoff kernel time, 2151.935 us device Q8 quantize time, and 16891.741 us output-projection time. This closes treating the FP32 full-core handoff as a multi-token state/correctness fix; keep it only as a one-token diagnostic frontier and do not rerun the 8-token variant without a new K/V or residual-state correction.

Added default-off --cpu-full-attention-kv-state as a carried-state correction, recomputing each current-token full-attention K/V state entry on CPU from the live GPU residual and appending those entries after the normal GPU current-token core. Generate-only codegen and local compile passed. The target run fired the diagnostic on all 80 full-attention layers, kept greedy top-1 and greedy prefix exact at 8/8, but exact top-k stayed 5/8 at 4.83245428 tok/s with the same failing tokens 3, 6, and 7. An earlier discarded in-core variant changed the current token's attention inputs and regressed to 4/8 with a token-0 top-k order mismatch, so the implemented route is append-only. This closes CPU full-attention K/V append from live residual as the missing state correction; do not rerun CPU K/V state recompute/append without a new full-attention projection or history-layout mismatch.

Added default-off --cpu-full-attention-core to recompute the current full-attention core/gate on CPU from live GPU Q/K/V history before the existing resident attention-front projection/residual path. Generate-only codegen and local compile passed. The target run fired the diagnostic on all 80 full-attention layers, kept greedy top-1 and greedy prefix exact at 8/8, but exact top-k regressed to 4/8 at 5.692343948 tok/s, failing steps 0, 3, 6, and 7. This is worse than the current FP32-core baseline and the CPU K/V append route, so CPU current-core/gate substitution is not the missing residual-state correction; do not rerun without a new full-attention core mismatch that supersedes this artifact.

Added default-off --cpu-linear-predelta-front to recompute the linear-attention pre-delta front on CPU from the live GPU-normalized input: preconv projections, convolution output/state, postconv q/k/v predelta vectors, gate/beta, and z, before feeding the existing recurrent delta and attention-front path. Generate-only codegen and local compile passed. The target run fired the diagnostic on all 240 linear layers, kept greedy top-1 and greedy prefix exact at 8/8, but exact top-k stayed 5/8 at 3.279721872 tok/s, failing steps 3, 4, and 7. It fixed token 6's top-k order versus the current FP32-core baseline but regressed token 4 and was much slower, so full CPU linear pre-delta substitution is not the missing early residual/state correction; do not combine it with already-closed CPU conv/postconv/delta variants without a new downstream source mismatch.

Added default-off --gpu-live-selected-cache-prewarm to skip native selected-cache warming, run an untimed live GPU decode pass on a copied state, populate resident selected Q4/Q6 handles from live router sets, then reset GPU state, resident linear state, cache hit/miss counters, and handoff timing counters before the measured FP32 full-core 8-token loop. Generate-only codegen passed and source inspection confirmed native selected warmup is gated off under the new flag. Target run built and emitted smoke JSON. The measured selected-cache misses fell to zero (gate-up/down/Q6 = 0/0/0) after prewarm misses 319/594/159, selected_ffn wall dropped versus the prior FP32 full-core 8-token state check from 436300762 to 207673294 ns, and diagnostic tok/s was 7.003897852. Required checks still failed: greedy top-1 and prefix stayed 8/8, but exact top-k remained 4/8 with the same failing steps 3, 4, 6, and 7. True selected-set drift also remains (step 0 first true-set mismatch at layer 35; steps 6 and 7 at layer 4). This proves live cache prewarm can remove measured selected-cache misses but is not a residual/state correctness fix; do not rerun live selected-cache prewarm alone or treat its tok/s as a speedup without a new upstream state correction.

Added default-off --cpu-shadow-state-each-token to advance a CPU shadow DecodeLoopState from the GPU-generated token stream, refresh the live GPU DecodeLoopState and resident linear recurrent buffers before the next token, and account the shadow update inside measured decode time. This is distinct from rejected oracle native-state realignment because it follows GPU-consumed tokens instead of future native traces. Generate-only codegen passed. The attention-front target run kept greedy top-1/prefix exact at 8/8 and improved exact top-k to 6/8, failing only steps 6 and 7, matching the prior oracle native-state realign failure shape; however it was far too slow at 1.050189157 tok/s because CPU shadow updates cost 6149126596 ns. The FP32 full-core handoff variant with the same shadow-state correction reached only 5/8 exact top-k at 1.098976545 tok/s, failing steps 3, 6, and 7, so full-core handoff still introduces a current-token failure even when carried state is refreshed. CPU shadow state proves deployable carried-state refresh fixes the token 3/4 drift in the attention-front path, but it is not a promotion route and does not solve the remaining token 6/7 early local residual drift; do not rerun CPU shadow-state alone or full-core+shadow variants without a new current-token residual correction.

Combined the deployable carried-state refresh (--cpu-shadow-state-each-token) with the closed current-token --cpu-linear-delta substitution to test whether exact CPU shadow state plus CPU recurrent linear delta closes the remaining token 6/7 drift. Generate-only codegen passed and the target built/emitted smoke JSON. Greedy top-1 and prefix stayed 8/8, but exact top-k regressed to 5/8 at 1.099464121 tok/s, failing steps 3, 6, and 7. The run kept token 7 layer-2 nearly exact, but layer-3 FFN residual still drifted by about 0.000129 from CPU-equivalent FFN amplification, and CPU shadow cost 5596344837 ns. This closes CPU linear-delta substitution even when paired with live CPU shadow state; do not rerun linear-delta+shadow combinations without a different FFN-boundary/input correction.

Added default-off --cpu-shadow-ffn-input-each-token, which precomputes the current token's CPU shadow trace from the GPU-generated token stream, uses the CPU shadow FFN residual/norm inputs for all FFN tails in the GPU pass, and refreshes the live state from the same shadow step. This is a correctness proof, not a promotion route: the target and confirmation both passed greedy top-1/prefix and exact top-k at 8/8, but throughput was only 1.070646588 and 1.016567613 tok/s because each measured loop includes a full CPU shadow token (6049908156/6413307179 ns) and 320 CPU-shadow FFN input substitutions. The pass proves the remaining multi-token failures are at the FFN-boundary input/residual contract: forcing the current-token FFN inputs removes router mismatches for steps 6/7 and keeps early layer outputs below the material drift threshold. Do not rerun the full CPU-shadow FFN-input route as a speed route; next distill this into a GPU-native or bounded FFN-boundary correction.

Added --cpu-shadow-ffn-input-layers and --cpu-shadow-ffn-input-no-state-refresh to narrow the prior all-layer CPU-shadow FFN-input proof. The L0-5 bounded route failed at 4/8 exact top-k, but progressively later FFN-boundary lists all passed, and the correction narrowed to only layer 39: target and confirmation with --cpu-shadow-ffn-input-layers 39 passed greedy top-1/prefix and exact top-k at 8/8 with only 8 substituted FFN inputs. A final no-state-refresh isolation also passed and confirmed at 8/8, proving the state refresh is not the necessary part of the correction; current-token layer-39 FFN-boundary input is sufficient to recover exact emitted top-k for this 8-token case even while earlier router/layer drift remains. This remains rejected for promotion because it still precomputes a full CPU shadow trace every token (4504880278-5487916912 ns in no-refresh runs, 1.141883516/1.329015366 tok/s). Do not rerun CPU-shadow L39/list variants as speed routes; next replace the CPU shadow source for layer-39 FFN input with a GPU-native or bounded final-layer FFN-boundary correction.

Using the confirmed CPU-shadow layer-39 FFN-boundary proof as the new source hypothesis, tested bounded live CPU final-layer corrections without CPU shadow: --cpu-layer-fallback-layers 39, --cpu-layer-fallback-layers 38,39, and layer-39 fallback with CPU LM-head. All three kept greedy top-1 and greedy prefix exact at 8/8, but exact top-k stayed 5/8, failing steps 3, 6, and 7. Throughput was 5.595875498 tok/s for L39, 5.337809763 tok/s for L38-39, and 5.014055579 tok/s for L39+CPU-LM. The L39 run still had live-vs-native FFN input drift at layer 39 on failing steps (cosines about 0.9942/0.9924/0.9913 and max_abs 0.1088/0.1351/0.1267 for steps 3/6/7), while the CPU-shadow L39 no-refresh proof made the same boundary exactly native and passed 8/8. This closes final-layer CPU fallback from live GPU residual as the replacement source: the missing correction is the layer-39 FFN-boundary input itself, requiring an upstream residual/state correction or a GPU-native boundary source, not live suffix CPU fallback or LM-head reruns.

Added --cpu-shadow-ffn-input-norm-only, --cpu-shadow-ffn-input-residual-only, and --cpu-shadow-ffn-input-recompute-norm to split the confirmed layer-39 CPU-shadow FFN-boundary proof. Norm-only substitution at layer 39 diverged after token 0 (top-1/prefix/top-k only 1/8), proving the native FFN norm cannot be mixed with the live residual/add base. Residual-only substitution kept greedy top-1/prefix exact but reached only 6/8 exact top-k, failing steps 6 and 7, so the live FFN norm remains insufficient. Residual-only plus recomputing FFN RMSNorm from that substituted residual passed target and confirmation at 8/8 exact top-k, with 1.061767118 and 1.149553761 tok/s while still spending 5985101706/5439311776 ns in CPU shadow state work. This narrows the required source to one vector: the current-token layer-39 FFN residual/add base; the FFN norm can be recomputed from that source. The route remains rejected for promotion because the residual source is still a full CPU shadow trace. Next replace the CPU shadow source for that layer-39 residual with an upstream residual/state correction or GPU-native boundary source.

Added --cpu-shadow-trace-no-state-refresh, --cpu-shadow-layer-input-layers, and --cpu-shadow-attention-output-layers to split the confirmed layer-39 FFN residual source into upstream layer input versus attention-output component while precomputing a CPU shadow trace without refreshing live GPU state. Layer-39 input substitution alone passed target and confirmation at 8/8 exact top-k (1.060779508/1.102628673 tok/s), while layer-39 attention-output-only substitution kept greedy top-1/prefix exact but stayed 6/8 exact top-k, failing steps 3 and 6. Moving one step upstream, layer-38 input substitution alone also passed target and confirmation at 8/8 exact top-k (1.0222897/1.108482644 tok/s) and made layer-39 input effectively exact without direct layer-39 substitution. This narrows the replacement source from the layer-39 FFN residual/add base to the current-token layer-38 input / layer-37 output source. The route remains rejected for promotion because the source is still a full CPU shadow trace costing 5.58-6.27 s per 8-token run. Next replace the CPU shadow source for layer-38 input with a GPU-native or bounded upstream residual/state correction.

With the source narrowed to layer-38 input / layer-37 output, tested whether a bounded live layer-37 CPU fallback could produce that source without CPU shadow. --cpu-layer-fallback-layers 37 kept greedy top-1/prefix exact but regressed exact top-k to 4/8 at 5.435074785 tok/s, failing steps 3, 4, 6, and 7; the layer-38 input remained the same drifting layer-37 output shape. A no-state-refresh CPU-shadow layer-37 input substitution improved exact top-k to 7/8 at 1.014511705 tok/s but still failed step 4. The layer-37 diagnostic-window rerun showed step 4's layer-37 input was exact and layer-37 attention/FFN same-input rows were effectively exact (layer-37 output max_abs 5.96e-7, attention output max_abs 5.66e-7, FFN output max_abs 3.58e-7), yet layer 38 amplified that sub-micro boundary delta to 0.008394 max_abs and layer 39 to 0.019638, enough to change the fifth top-k id. This closes live layer-37 CPU fallback and shadow layer-37 input alone as replacements for the exact layer-38 boundary source. Next use an exact/compensated layer-38 input source or a concrete layer-38/39 sensitivity correction; do not rerun L37 fallback/shadow-input variants alone.

Tested the concrete L38/L39 sensitivity-correction follow-up to the failed shadow layer-37 input route: exact CPU-shadow layer-37 input with no state refresh, then CPU native fallback for layers 38 and 39. The route kept greedy top-1/prefix exact and fixed the prior step-4 top-k miss, but exact top-k still reached only 7/8 at 1.13262848 tok/s, now failing step 6 with the fourth and fifth IDs swapped. CPU fallback fired for 16 suffix layers and CPU shadow state still cost 5455666390 ns. The boundary trace shows the near-exact layer-38 input was still amplified through the suffix (step 6 L38 input max_abs 1.07e-6, L38 output 0.004836, L39 output 0.020776), so CPU suffix fallback is not a reliable compensation for a non-exact layer-38 boundary. Do not rerun CPU L38/L39 suffix compensation from shadow L37 input alone; the replacement still needs an exact/compensated layer-38 input source or a different concrete L38/L39 correction.

Added default-off --cpu-shadow-layer-input-affine-layers, --cpu-shadow-layer-input-affine-bias, and --cpu-shadow-layer-input-affine-block-size to test whether the passing top-1024 layer-38 input delta can be replaced by a low-parameter per-token scale/bias predictor. Added default-off --cpu-shadow-layer-input-lagged-delta-layers and --cpu-shadow-layer-input-lagged-delta-topk to test whether the previous token's CPU-shadow-minus-live layer-38 input delta can predict the current token's correction values.
